scope: Reported end-to-end training results from the private experiment logs. These numbers are not produced by the standalone microbenchmark scripts.
hardware: Single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell 96 GB, as recorded in the experiment reports.
caveats: The result is specific to the short-sequence sliding-window mechanism-isolation benchmark.
Experiment 27 used the sequential recurrence path with TBPTT detach; experiment 28 used the parallel scan path with full scan backpropagation.
Capacity rows are noisier than the main accuracy numbers because they come from one accumulation run.
